citations.assessment: Rav Ashi of Avirya gives a ruling in Rabbi Zeira’s name. Rav Ashi without the locative appears shortly before.
The checked Rashi glosses me-Avirya as a place. It gives no separate identification of Ozranya.

holds.reason: The alternative Ozranya remains a reported reading. The proposed date relative to Ravina and Rav Ashi remains Heilprin’s inference.
